name: Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation
prerequisites: Both cards in hand; {U}{U}{B} available. No other requirement.
steps: Main phase, with {U}{U}{B} untapped: cast Thassa's Oracle ({U}{U}).
If Oracle resolves, its enters trigger goes on the stack. Hold priority (or wait for the trigger to be on the stack).

In response to the trigger, cast Demonic Consultation ({B}). On resolution name a card that is NOT in your library (safe default: 'Demonic Consultation' itself, which is on the stack, or any card already in hand/graveyard/exile). The whole library is exiled.
Oracle trigger resolves with 0 cards in library: X (devotion to blue, at least 2) >= 0, you win.

Fallback order (Spellbook's): Consultation first naming Thassa's Oracle while Oracle is in hand, then cast Oracle. Bot should prefer the Oracle-first order so a countered Oracle does not leave it with an exiled library.
mana_needed: {U}{U}{B} on the go-off turn; 3 total (both pieces are cast that turn)
weak_to: Counterspell on Thassa's Oracle (Talrand 13 counters, Etrata B4 Force of Will/Fierce Guardianship); trigger/ability stifles; Opposition Agent does not matter (no search). Graveyard hate irrelevant.
beats_field: Best line vs Edgar/Ur-Dragon/Krenko/Ghalta/Azusa (no permanents to remove, nothing to wipe); vs Talrand/Etrata needs a protection spell (Silence, Grand Abolisher, own counter) or bait first.

name: Thassa's Oracle + Tainted Pact
prerequisites: Both in hand; {1}{U}{U}{B}. Library must contain no two cards with the same name (Spellbook prereq) -> at most ONE copy of each basic land in the deck, or Pact stops early.
steps: Cast Thassa's Oracle ({U}{U}); let it resolve; Oracle trigger on the stack.
In response cast Tainted Pact ({1}{B}). On resolution, decline to put every exiled card into hand; it keeps exiling until the library is empty.
Oracle trigger resolves with an empty library: win.
weak_to: Counters on Oracle; duplicate names in library (basics) stop Pact; Pact is not in the engine yet.
beats_field: Same profile as Consultation: immune to removal/wipes/graveyard hate, needs counter protection vs Talrand/Etrata.

name: Thassa's Oracle + Thought Lash
prerequisites: Thought Lash on the battlefield (cast earlier for {2}{U}{U}); Oracle in hand; {U}{U}.
steps: Turn N: cast Thought Lash ({2}{U}{U}).

Turn N+1 upkeep: pay cumulative upkeep (exile 1 card per age counter) - do NOT decline, or the library is exiled with no Oracle ready (that is still fine only if Oracle is in hand and castable this turn).

Main phase: cast Thassa's Oracle ({U}{U}); with its trigger on the stack, activate Thought Lash's last ability repeatedly ('Exile the top card of your library') until the library is empty (ruling 2008-10-01: cannot activate with an empty library, so stop at 0).
Oracle trigger resolves with an empty library: win.
weak_to: Counter on Oracle; enchantment removal on Thought Lash before the go-off turn (Ur-Dragon, Azusa, Ghalta, Krenko carry artifact/enchantment answers) - but the bot can respond to removal by NOT exiling (just let it die). Not in engine (Thought Lash).
beats_field: Only colorless-free blue Oracle line for Brago (no black); exposed to enchantment hate one turn, otherwise like Consultation.

name: Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond + Brain Freeze (+ Thassa's Oracle finish)
prerequisites: Breach and LED on the battlefield (or cast this turn), Brain Freeze in hand or graveyard, at least six other cards in hand and/or graveyard (Spellbook). Thassa's Oracle anywhere it will end up in graveyard/hand. Need {1}{U} to start if Brain Freeze is in hand.
steps: Cast Underworld Breach ({1}{R}) and Lion's Eye Diamond ({0}).
Cast Brain Freeze from hand targeting YOURSELF (mill 3 x copies). (If it is already in the graveyard, skip.)
Activate LED: discard hand, sacrifice it, add {U}{U}{U}.

Loop: escape LED (pay {0} + exile three graveyard cards other than Brain Freeze and Thassa's Oracle) -> activate it for {U}{U}{U} -> escape Brain Freeze ({1}{U} + exile three) targeting yourself; storm copies all target yourself until your library is empty, then aim spare copies at opponents.
Repeat until your library is in the graveyard. Keep 3 spare cards for the final escape.
Escape Thassa's Oracle from the graveyard ({U}{U} + exile three other cards). Its trigger resolves with an empty library: win.
mana_needed: {1}{R} for Breach + {1}{U} for first Brain Freeze; ~4 total; the loop then nets mana
result: Mill yourself and win with escaped Thassa's Oracle (Spellbook itself only lists near-infinite mill/storm/mana)
weak_to: Graveyard hate (Shred Memory in two Etrata lists only); artifact/enchantment removal on Breach before the turn; counters on Breach or Oracle; Breach is sacrificed at end step (sorcery-turn window). Breach, LED, Brain Freeze not in engine. Long loop = most complex bot script.
beats_field: Graveyard is safe in this field, but needs three cards not in the engine and is the hardest script; keep as backup.

name: Hermit Druid + Thassa's Oracle
prerequisites: No basic land cards in library (deck construction). Hermit Druid not summoning sick. {G} + {U}{U}.
steps: Cast Hermit Druid ({1}{G}) a turn earlier.
Go-off turn: cast Thassa's Oracle ({U}{U}); with its trigger on the stack, activate Hermit Druid ({G},{T}). With no basics, it reveals and bins the entire library (ruling 2025-01-24).
Oracle trigger resolves with 0 cards: win.
weak_to: Any removal on Hermit Druid (Edgar/Ur-Dragon 8 each) during the turn it is summoning sick; counter on Oracle; forces a basic-free five-color mana base. Hermit Druid not in engine.
beats_field: Weaker than Consultation here: creature exposed to the field's targeted removal for a full turn cycle.

name: Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal
prerequisites: Scepter on the battlefield with Dramatic Reversal imprinted; nonland permanents (rocks/dorks) that tap for at least {3} total (Spellbook prereq). Outlet: Walking Ballista in hand or on battlefield.
steps: Setup turn: cast Isochron Scepter ({2}); on its enter trigger exile Dramatic Reversal from hand.
Go-off (main phase): tap every mana rock/dork (>= {3}).
Activate Scepter ({2},{T}); cast the copy of Dramatic Reversal; it untaps all nonland permanents (rocks and Scepter).
Repeat steps 2-3; each loop nets (rock mana - 2). Do it N times to bank N x net mana (infinite storm too).
Cast Walking Ballista with X large enough (X >= 40 per living opponent's life total, e.g. X = 120 -> {240}) and remove counters to deal damage to each opponent until all lose.
mana_needed: {2}+{1}{U} setup (4); go-off needs rocks producing >= 3 plus 0 extra
result: Infinite mana from nonland permanents + infinite storm -> Walking Ballista for infinite damage
weak_to: Artifact removal on Scepter (Ur-Dragon 6, Azusa/Ghalta/Krenko 4 each); rock removal; counter on Scepter. All pieces in engine.
beats_field: In-engine and well-known (Talrand runs it), but artifact-dependent against four decks with artifact hate; go off the turn Scepter lands if possible.

name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned + Walking Ballista
prerequisites: Both on the battlefield; Walking Ballista has at least TWO +1/+1 counters (Spellbook prereq; with one counter it dies to SBA before Heliod's trigger resolves - Heliod ruling 2020-01-24). {1}{W} available.
steps: Cast Heliod ({2}{W}) and Walking Ballista with X=2 ({4}) on earlier turns or the same turn.
Activate Heliod's {1}{W}: target Walking Ballista gains lifelink.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Ballista: 1 damage to an opponent; lifelink gains 1 life; Heliod trigger targets Ballista: +1/+1 counter.
Repeat step 3 (each loop is counter-neutral) 40 times per opponent (or each opponent's current life), then move to the next opponent.
Can be done at instant speed, e.g. in response to removal on either piece.
weak_to: Removal on Ballista in response to the Heliod activation (Edgar/Ur-Dragon targeted removal; Shalai blanks it); Heliod is indestructible but exiled/bounced by Swords, Rift, Generous Gift; counters on either piece. Both in engine.
beats_field: Best creature line: two cards, in engine, instant speed, and under Shalai's hexproof the Ballista cannot be targeted; dies only to wipes before go-off.

name: Archangel of Thune + Spike Feeder (+ Walking Ballista or combat)
prerequisites: Archangel and Spike Feeder on the battlefield, Feeder with >= 2 +1/+1 counters (Spellbook easy prereq). For a kill: Walking Ballista on the battlefield with >= 1 counter, or Archangel able to attack.
steps: Cast Spike Feeder ({1}{G}{G}, enters with 2 counters) and Archangel of Thune ({3}{W}{W}).
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Spike Feeder: you gain 2 life (Oracle says 2; Spellbook's description says 1).
Archangel trigger: +1/+1 counter on each creature you control (Feeder back to its count, Ballista +1).
Repeat steps 2-3 as often as wanted (e.g. 200 times): infinite life and arbitrarily large creatures.
Kill: remove Ballista counters to deal damage to each opponent; or, without Ballista, attack with the huge flying lifelink Archangel and other creatures.
result: Infinite life and +1/+1 counters; infinite damage with Walking Ballista
weak_to: Removal on Archangel in response (instant-speed loop can respond, but each loop needs Archangel alive); wipes. All in engine.
beats_field: Strong under Shalai: both pieces hexproof; Feeder loop is free so it can win in response to a wipe if Ballista is out.

name: Devoted Druid + Vizier of Remedies (+ Walking Ballista)
prerequisites: Devoted Druid not summoning sick; Vizier on the battlefield. Walking Ballista in hand (or Shalai/other outlet).
steps: Cast Devoted Druid ({1}{G}) a turn early; cast Vizier of Remedies ({1}{W}).
Main phase: tap Druid for {G}; activate 'Put a -1/-1 counter on this creature: Untap' - Vizier reduces it to zero counters (Devoted Druid ruling 2018-12-07 allows activation).
Repeat N times for N green mana (e.g. 250).
Cast Walking Ballista with X = 120 (pay 240 green) and shoot each opponent for 40 (or their life).
Alternative outlet: Shalai's {4}{G}{G} as many times as wanted, then attack (needs combat, weaker).
mana_needed: 0 extra on go-off (Ballista paid by the loop); 4 total for the two pieces
result: Infinite green mana -> Walking Ballista infinite damage
weak_to: Removal on Druid or Vizier (Shalai blanks targeted); wipes; Druid must survive a turn. All in engine.
beats_field: Cheap, all in engine; under Shalai only wipes and Shalai removal interfere; the mana loop is not stoppable by counters but Ballista can be countered (Talrand).

name: Devoted Druid + Swift Reconfiguration (+ Walking Ballista)
prerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attached to Devoted Druid (Spellbook prereq). Once it is a noncreature Vehicle artifact, -1/-1 counters cannot kill it and summoning sickness does not apply (rules inference, not a Spellbook statement: verify in engine).
steps: Cast Devoted Druid ({1}{G}).
Cast Swift Reconfiguration ({W}, flash) targeting Devoted Druid.
Tap Druid for {G}; put a -1/-1 counter on it to untap it; repeat N times (counters do not matter on a noncreature).
Cast Walking Ballista with large X and shoot opponents.
mana_needed: {W} on go-off (if Druid already out); 3 total
weak_to: Enchantment/artifact removal on the Aura'd Druid (it is an artifact now: Ur-Dragon/Azusa/Ghalta/Krenko); counters. Swift Reconfiguration not in engine.
beats_field: Second copy of the Druid package; the flash Aura means Druid can be enchanted the turn it lands (unverified summoning-sickness interaction) - one-turn kill out of nowhere.

name: Trostani, Selesnya's Voice + Scurry Oak + Archangel of Thune
prerequisites: Trostani and Archangel on the battlefield; a way to gain life (casting Scurry Oak does it: Trostani gains life equal to its toughness). Ballista on battlefield for the kill (optional; otherwise attack).
steps: Have Trostani (commander) and Archangel of Thune on the battlefield.
Cast Scurry Oak ({2}{G}): Trostani trigger, gain 2 life.
Archangel trigger: +1/+1 counter on each creature, including Scurry Oak -> Scurry Oak trigger: create a 1/1 Squirrel.
Squirrel enters: Trostani gains 1 life -> Archangel: counters on everything -> Oak makes another Squirrel. Repeat as long as wanted (Oak's token is 'may', so the bot stops it).
Kill: Ballista counters at opponents, or attack with the giant creatures.
result: Infinite life, tokens and +1/+1 counters (infinite damage with Ballista)
weak_to: Three pieces; removal on Archangel or Trostani; wipes. Scurry Oak not in engine.
beats_field: Only for the Trostani A/B; worse than Heliod/Archangel+Feeder because Trostani is not hexproof.

name: Rosie Cotton of South Lane + Basking Broodscale (+ Walking Ballista)
prerequisites: Basking Broodscale on the battlefield; Rosie in hand; {2}{W}.
steps: Cast Basking Broodscale ({1}{G}).

Cast Rosie Cotton ({2}{W}): ETB creates a Food -> Rosie trigger: +1/+1 counter on target Broodscale -> Broodscale: create an Eldrazi Spawn -> Rosie trigger again (target Broodscale) -> repeat N times (Broodscale's token is 'may').
Sacrifice Spawns for {C} each: N colorless mana.
Cast Walking Ballista with X large and shoot opponents.
result: Infinite colorless mana, tokens, counters -> Walking Ballista
weak_to: Removal on Broodscale before Rosie; counter on Rosie. Neither in engine.
beats_field: Cheap two-card GW mana engine; with Shalai out Broodscale is hexproof, so only counters (Talrand) stop it.

name: Earthcraft + Squirrel Nest (+ Ashnod's Altar + Walking Ballista)
prerequisites: Squirrel Nest attached to a BASIC land you control (Earthcraft untaps basic lands only). Needs an outlet: Spellbook result is only infinite tapped tokens.
steps: Cast Earthcraft ({1}{G}), Squirrel Nest ({1}{G}{G}) on a basic land, Ashnod's Altar ({3}).
Tap the enchanted land: create a Squirrel. Earthcraft: tap that Squirrel to untap the land. Repeat N times.
Sacrifice Squirrels to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C} each.
Cast Walking Ballista with large X.
result: Infinite tapped Squirrels (+ Altar: infinite colorless mana -> Ballista)
weak_to: Enchantment/artifact removal (Ur-Dragon, Azusa, Ghalta, Krenko); needs 4 pieces for a kill; Earthcraft and Squirrel Nest not in engine.
beats_field: Weak here: three non-creature permanents that Shalai cannot protect and four bot decks can destroy.

name: Basalt Monolith + Forsaken Monument (+ Walking Ballista)
prerequisites: Both on the battlefield. Ruling (Forsaken Monument 2020-09-25): tapping for more than one {C} adds only one extra, so Basalt makes {C}{C}{C}{C} and untapping costs {3}: net +1 per loop.
steps: Cast Basalt Monolith ({3}) and Forsaken Monument ({5}).
Tap Basalt for {C}{C}{C} (+{C} from Monument). Pay {3}: untap Basalt. Repeat N times for N colorless.
Cast Walking Ballista (X large; it also gets +2/+2 from Monument) and shoot.
weak_to: Artifact removal; counters; 8 mana of setup. All in engine.
beats_field: Fully in engine and colorless (fits all three commanders), but two artifacts in front of four decks with artifact hate.

name: Basalt Monolith + Rings of Brighthearth (+ Walking Ballista)
prerequisites: Both on the battlefield; {2} extra to start (Spellbook).
steps: Tap Basalt for {C}{C}{C}. Activate its untap ability ({3}).
Rings trigger: pay {2}, copy the untap ability. Copy resolves first (Rings ruling 2020-11-10): Basalt untaps; tap it again for {C}{C}{C}.
Original untap ability resolves: Basalt untaps. Net +1 per cycle. Repeat.
Cast Walking Ballista with large X.
weak_to: Artifact removal; Rings not in engine.
beats_field: Same as Monument version but cheaper; Rings needs engine work.

name: Basalt Monolith or Grim Monolith + Power Artifact (+ Walking Ballista)
prerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Basalt Monolith (untap costs {1}, net +2) or Grim Monolith (untap costs {2}, net +1). Only one Monolith is needed.
steps: Cast the Monolith, then Power Artifact ({U}{U}) enchanting it.
Tap Monolith for {C}{C}{C}; pay reduced untap cost; repeat N times.
Cast Walking Ballista with large X.
weak_to: Artifact or enchantment removal on either piece; Power Artifact not in engine. Grim Monolith is a Game Changer.
beats_field: Two cheap permanents, both exposed to Ur-Dragon/Azusa/Ghalta/Krenko hate; fine as redundancy with Scepter rocks.

name: Displacer Kitten + Teferi, Time Raveler + Sol Ring (+ Thassa's Oracle)
prerequisites: Kitten and Teferi on the battlefield, Sol Ring in hand, {1}. Main phase (loyalty abilities). Thassa's Oracle to finish.
steps: Cast Sol Ring ({1}): Kitten trigger blinks Teferi (fresh loyalty object).
Tap Sol Ring for {C}{C}. Teferi -3: return Sol Ring to hand, draw a card.
Recast Sol Ring ({1}): Kitten blinks Teferi again. Net +{C} and +1 card per loop. Repeat until the library is empty (stop before drawing from an empty library).
With the library at 0, cast Thassa's Oracle ({U}{U}, from lands or banked colorless is not enough - keep {U}{U} from lands): win. Alternatively use banked colorless for Walking Ballista.
result: Near-infinite colorless mana and card draw (bounded by library) -> Thassa's Oracle win
weak_to: Removal on Kitten (Edgar/Ur-Dragon); Teferi attacked; counters on Sol Ring do nothing - Teferi's static stops opponents casting at instant speed, so Talrand cannot counter during the loop. Kitten and Teferi not in engine.
beats_field: Teferi turns off Talrand's instant-speed counters, which is the main threat; but Kitten is a fragile 2/2 in front of 8-removal decks.

name: Peregrine Drake + Ghostly Flicker + Archaeomancer (or Mnemonic Wall)
prerequisites: Drake and Archaeomancer (or Mnemonic Wall) on the battlefield, Ghostly Flicker in hand; five lands that make {3}{U} for net mana (Spellbook).
steps: Tap five lands. Cast Ghostly Flicker ({2}{U}) targeting Peregrine Drake and Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer returns Ghostly Flicker to hand; Drake untaps five lands.
Repeat N times (net +2 mana with five lands of which one makes U); infinite storm/ETB.
Cast Walking Ballista with large X in the main phase.
result: Infinite land mana, infinite ETB/storm -> Ballista
weak_to: Removal on either creature (they sit for a turn); counter on Flicker. Drake and Mnemonic Wall not in engine (Archaeomancer and Ghostly Flicker are).
beats_field: Three pieces, two fragile creatures; mid-tier for Brago.

name: Brago, King Eternal + Strionic Resonator (+ mana rocks + Walking Ballista)
prerequisites: Brago can attack (no summoning sickness) and is not blocked; Strionic Resonator untapped; artifacts tapping for >= {2} (Sol Ring) - plus at least one more rock to net mana; Walking Ballista on the battlefield for the kill (it is not blinked).
steps: Attack with Brago. When it deals combat damage, its trigger goes on the stack: target Strionic Resonator, Sol Ring and every other mana rock (choose ALL of them - copies keep the same NUMBER of targets, rule-of-copies nuance; not verified by a Spellbook note).
In response: tap Sol Ring and the other rocks for mana.
Activate Strionic Resonator ({2},{T}) copying Brago's trigger; new targets: the same rocks and Resonator.
Copy resolves: rocks and Resonator are exiled and return untapped.
Repeat steps 2-4 (Brago's original trigger is still on the stack). With rocks beyond Sol Ring, each loop nets mana.
Spend the banked colorless on Walking Ballista's {4}: add a counter, then remove counters for 1 damage each to opponents. All of this happens in the combat damage step.
mana_needed: 0 on go-off; Brago 4 + Resonator 2 + Sol Ring 1 + Ballista
result: Infinite blinks + infinite colorless mana (Spellbook) -> Ballista damage (composed, not a Spellbook entry)
weak_to: Brago removal or blockers (Ur-Dragon dragons fly; Talrand drakes fly); artifact removal on Resonator; Brago not in engine.
beats_field: The only Brago-enabled infinite; needs Brago to connect, which the flying Talrand/Ur-Dragon boards contest. Rank below the non-combat lines.

name: Brago + Archaeomancer + Time Warp (extra-turn loop)
prerequisites: Brago can attack and connect every turn; Archaeomancer on the battlefield; Time Warp in hand; {3}{U}{U} each turn.
steps: Main phase 1: cast Time Warp ({3}{U}{U}) targeting yourself.
Combat: attack with Brago; on combat damage target Archaeomancer (plus any rocks/lands-free permanents worth blinking).
Archaeomancer re-enters: return Time Warp to hand.
Next (extra) turn: repeat. Win by attacking over many turns.
weak_to: Brago blocked or removed; counter on Time Warp; flying blockers. Brago not in engine.
beats_field: Grindy and combat-dependent; a backup Brago plan, not a turn-5 kill.

name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Zealous Conscripts (or Splinter Twin + Conscripts)
prerequisites: Both on the battlefield (Kiki has haste). Do it in your main phase 1 or beginning of combat. Splinter Twin on Zealous Conscripts is the same loop (Spellbook 1537-4702).
steps: Tap Kiki-Jiki: token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
Token ETB: gain control of Kiki-Jiki (target Kiki), untap it.
Repeat N times (e.g. 60). Optionally aim spare triggers at opponents' blockers/mana to steal and untap them.
Attack with all hasty tokens (tokens are sacrificed at end step).
weak_to: Removal on Kiki in response to the first activation; fog effects; wipes before combat. Both in engine.
beats_field: In engine and Krenko runs the same line, but it needs combat and RRR; middling vs removal-heavy Edgar/Ur-Dragon.

name: Kiki-Jiki + Restoration Angel / Felidar Guardian / Pestermite / Deceiver Exarch
prerequisites: Kiki on the battlefield; partner creature cast (Resto/Pestermite/Exarch have flash, Felidar does not).
steps: (Resto) Flash in Restoration Angel at the end of the last opponent's turn, or in your turn.
Your turn, main phase 1: tap Kiki targeting Resto: hasty token Resto enters, its trigger blinks Kiki (Felidar: blink Kiki; Pestermite/Exarch: untap Kiki).
Kiki returns untapped (haste): repeat N times.
Attack with all tokens.
weak_to: Same as Conscripts; Resto, Felidar, Pestermite, Exarch are not in engine.
beats_field: Redundancy for the Kiki package only.

name: Dualcaster Mage + Twinflame
prerequisites: You control at least one creature; {2}{R}{R}{R} in one main phase.
steps: Cast Twinflame ({1}{R}) targeting any creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage ({1}{R}{R}, flash). Its ETB copies Twinflame; new target: Dualcaster Mage.
Copy resolves: hasty token Dualcaster enters, its ETB copies Twinflame again targeting the newest Dualcaster. Repeat N times.
Let the original Twinflame resolve, then attack with all hasty tokens.
weak_to: Counter on Twinflame/Dualcaster; fogs/instant wipes in combat. Neither card in engine.
beats_field: Both pieces from hand in one turn, nothing on the board to remove: good vs Edgar/Ur-Dragon; needs combat.

name: Sanguine Bond + Exquisite Blood
prerequisites: Both on the battlefield; any life gain (lifelink, a land, Trostani, etc.).
steps: Gain any life.
Sanguine Bond: target opponent loses that much -> Exquisite Blood: you gain that much -> Bond again (retarget the next opponent once one is dead).
Repeat until all opponents are at 0.
weak_to: Enchantment removal (4 bot decks); 10 mana of enchantments. Both in engine.
beats_field: Edgar and Corrupted Etrata run this exact line; too slow for a turn 5-6 Child plan. Low priority.

name: Coalition Victory with Child of Alara on the battlefield
prerequisites: Child of Alara on the battlefield (a creature of all five colors - Coalition Victory ruling 2006-09-25: a single multicolored creature counts for all its colors); lands with all five basic land types (basics, typed duals or Triomes; one Triome + typed dual can cover all five); {3}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
steps: Cast Child of Alara from the command zone ({W}{U}{B}{R}{G}).
Ensure Plains, Island, Swamp, Mountain and Forest types are all on the battlefield.
Cast Coalition Victory: if Child is still there on resolution, win.
mana_needed: 8 on the go-off turn (13 if Child is cast the same turn)
weak_to: Removal on Child (then Child's death trigger destroys all nonland permanents - the bot's own too); counter on an 8-drop; land destruction (Azusa). Neither Child nor Coalition Victory is in the engine.
beats_field: Late closer only. NOT on Commander Spellbook as Child + Coalition Victory (only Leyline of the Guildpact + Coalition Victory, 1024-5364).
